python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# NASA outlay data in millions for FY 2008-2017
# From 2012 bulletin: 2008-2012
# From 2017 bulletin: 2013-2017
nasa_outlays = {
    2008: 17834,
    2009: 19168,
    2010: 18906,
    2011: 17617,
    2012: 17190,
    2013: 16978,
    2014: 17093,
    2015: 18272,
    2016: 18828,
    2017: 18698
}

# Convert to billions
values = [v/1000 for v in nasa_outlays.values()]
print("NASA outlays (billions) for FY 2008-2017:")
for year, val in nasa_outlays.items():
    print(f"  {year}: {val/1000:.3f}")

# Sort values
sorted_values = sorted(values)
print(f"\nSorted values: {sorted_values}")

# 10% Winsorized: For n=10, 10% = 1
# Replace the smallest 10% (1 value) with the next smallest value
# Replace the largest 10% (1 value) with the next largest value
winsorized = sorted_values.copy()
winsorized[0] = sorted_values[1]  # Replace smallest with 2nd smallest
winsorized[-1] = sorted_values[-2]  # Replace largest with 2nd largest

print(f"Winsorized values: {winsorized}")
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range:")
print(f"  Min: {min(winsorized):.2f}")
print(f"  Max: {max(winsorized):.2f}")
print(f"  Range: {max(winsorized) - min(winsorized):.2f}")

# The range is the difference
range_value = max(winsorized) - min(winsorized)
print(f"\n10% Winsorized range = {range_value:.2f} billion dollars")
EOF
